description.text: 1. Why choose to study this program in Software College (SC)? English Taught Program Collaborate with International IT Enterprises Professional and Personal Support ProfoundChinese Culture Low Expenses 2. Teaching Objective Be practical, compound and internationalized talents who can have the globalized professional aspects. Master the basic theoretical knowledge and internationally advanced development technologies in the field of software engineering. Have the ability of software development and management, skills of system analysis, design, implementation and project management. Have the innovation and teamwork spirits and pioneering consciousness, and can meet the development needs and the international trends. 3. Main Courses ○ Advanced Mathematics ○ Discrete Mathematics ○ Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics ○ Linear Algebra ○ Introduction to Major and Career Planning ○ Introduction of Computer Programming(C Programming Language) ○ C++ Programming ○ Principles of Computer Organization ○ Computer Network ○ Data Structure ○ Operating System ○ Principles of Database ○ Software Engineering ○ Java Programming ○ Object-Oriented Programming and Design ○ Software Architecture and Design Pattern ○ Algorithms Analysis and Design ○ Software Requirements Analysis and Design ○ Software Testing ○ JSP and Servlet Techniques ○ Chinese Language Note: All the courses(except Chinese language) are given in English. 95% major courses are given by foreign teachers from USA, UK or Ireland. 4. Duration 4 years 5. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor of Software Engineering byNortheastern University 6. Future Career The Software College excels in strengthening students’ practical ability and enhancing their adaptability for future work. Consequently, all undergraduate students join different companies in the 7th semester for internships and further practical training. The Software College cooperates closely with companies at home and abroad and hasestablished joint laboratories with IBM and Neusoft, etc. Off-campus practice bases have been founded in more than 20 companies, including IBM, Alibaba, Baidu, etc.

duration.text: The Software Engineering at Northeastern University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Hand in the highest diploma and transcripts. 2. Passport copy and passport size photograph.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be under the age of 25. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 3. Applicants must have high school certificate or will high school certificate by September 2015.
